verdict.rationale: The xAI API documents very broad programmatic coverage: text, tools, multi-agent research, image generation and editing, video generation, editing and extension, TTS, STT, voice cloning, files and collections, a Management API for teams and billing, and gRPC parity with REST. However, nothing states parity with the UI, and some controls are documented only in the Console, such as the ZDR toggle in Team Settings and per-team rate limits viewable in the Console. missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement, evidence that Console-only settings (ZDR toggle, rate-limit views) are API-accessible, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Management API serves as a dedicated interface to the xAI platform, empowering developers and teams to programmatically manage their xAI API teams.
The xAI gRPC API exposes the same models and services as the REST API over gRPC.
Generate images from text prompts with Grok Imagine models.
Generate videos from text prompts with Grok video models.
Clone a voice from a short reference clip and use it anywhere a built-in voice works.
